name: checkpoint kinase 2

function.text: CHEK2 encodes the CHK2 checkpoint kinase, which transmits DNA-damage signals to regulators of cell-cycle progression and other stress responses.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include CHEK2-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
